policy.model: Inferred terminal station spurs along the retained southern FOT station curve, connected only to the northern Fribourg Nord–Givisiez approach. Exact original TPF S20/S21 patterns and platforms; original station point, GTFS calls and coordinates retained. No assertion of individual running-track alignment.

documents.title: SBB Fribourg/Freiburg station plan
documents.review: Pages 1–2 show platform 4/5, sectors A–H and the northern exits towards Murten/Morat and Neuchâtel. The published 4A–D GTFS variant keeps its original distinct ID and identical platform-4 coordinates. This 2025 plan supports station layout, not precise 2026 running tracks or source geometry freshness.

source.validityNote: Catalogue dates and verified bytes do not establish September 2026 alignment validity. Inferred infrastructure paths, not certified service running tracks.
source.transformation: Existing XTF parser with zero-metre Douglas–Peucker tolerance; collinear vertices may be removed. Approximate LV95-to-WGS84 transformation rounded to six decimals. Bern preserves original GTFS coordinates and rounds only final attachment endpoints to seven decimals.

scope: Exact TPF S20/S21 route identities; nine directed Givisiez–Fribourg original platform bindings; 37 complete original terminal contexts and 25 original stop records pinned. Three bounded spurs retain the southern station curve and connect solely to the northern approach through the unchanged federal station point. September fixtures only. Existing cantonal and cross-canton paths remain authoritative. All complete input-pattern contexts must agree. Federal source date and September 2025 station plan do not certify current running tracks or alignment.
